In the context of everyday life, windows bring in light and provide a view of the outside world. Similarly, the name Janela reflects the idea of opening up to new opportunities, experiences, and perspectives. The name can also be associated with the beauty and elegance of Portuguese culture, as windows are often seen as decorative elements in traditional Portuguese architecture.

By embracing the name Janela, we are reminding ourselves to keep our spiritual windows open and to remain open to receive God's love and guidance.
